notes: Project budget planning and tracking. Composite key; no top-level modification timestamp.The key includes inventoryNumber (always present, '<N/A>' when the line has no inventory item): two lines of one project, task and account group differ only by inventory item. The pilot tenant never has two, so [projectID, projectTaskID, accountGroupID] passed there; Aquatiq Food Factory returned 2,056 rows, 64 of them sharing that key with another row (measured 2026-10-01).
